questions.prompt: What color is «красный» in «На столе лежит красный карандаш»?
questions.explain: Красный means 'red'; the sentence says a red pencil is lying on the table.

questions.prompt: What does «зелёный» mean?
questions.explain: Зелёный means 'green', as in «На столе лежит зелёный карандаш» (a green pencil).

questions.prompt: How would you say 'blue' in the sky-blue / light-blue sense in Russian?
questions.explain: Голубой is light/sky-blue, as in «Сегодня небо совсем голубое»; синий is the darker blue.

questions.prompt: In «Над городом синее небо», what shade does «синий» name?
questions.explain: Синий is dark blue, distinct from the lighter голубой; here it describes the deep blue sky over the city.

questions.prompt: Which form correctly completes «Красная ___ находится в Москве» (the famous square)?
questions.explain: Площадь is feminine, so the color takes the feminine ending: «Красная площадь».

questions.prompt: What does «У неё красное платье» say in English?
options: She put on a red hat.
questions.explain: Красное платье is the neuter form agreeing with платье (dress): 'she has a red dress'.

questions.prompt: Pick the correct color form for «В саду растут ___ розы» (roses are plural).
questions.explain: Розы is plural, so the color takes the plural ending: «красные розы».

questions.prompt: How would you say 'yellow' in Russian?
questions.explain: Жёлтый means 'yellow', as in «На небе светит жёлтый месяц».

questions.prompt: What does «Осенью падают жёлтые листья» mean?
questions.explain: Жёлтые листья is 'yellow leaves'; the sentence describes them falling in autumn (осенью).

questions.prompt: Which form completes «На дереве висит ___ яблоко» (apple is neuter, yellow)?
questions.explain: Яблоко is neuter, so the color takes the neuter ending: «жёлтое яблоко».

questions.prompt: What color is «серый» in «По двору ходит серый кот»?
questions.explain: Серый means 'grey'; the sentence describes a grey cat walking through the courtyard.

questions.prompt: What does «За окном плывут серые облака» say in English?
options: Grey clouds drift past the window.
A grey cat walks through the yard.
Yellow tulips grow in the bed.
questions.explain: Серые облака means 'grey clouds'; they are drifting (плывут) past the window.

questions.prompt: What does «золотой» mean?
questions.explain: Золотой means 'golden' (and 'gold' as a material), as in «На пальце блестит золотой перстень».

questions.prompt: Which form completes «Спортсмен завоевал ___ медаль» (medal is feminine accusative, golden)?
questions.explain: Медаль is feminine and is the direct object, so the color takes the feminine accusative ending: «золотую медаль».

questions.prompt: In «У него голубой шарф» and «Я купил синий костюм», which statement about голубой and синий is correct?
options: Голубой is light/sky-blue and синий is dark blue.
Голубой is dark blue and синий is light blue.
Both mean exactly the same shade.
Голубой means green and синий means grey.
questions.explain: Russian splits blue into two basic colors: голубой (light/sky-blue) and синий (dark blue).

questions.prompt: How would you say 'a green bag' (she has one), as in the lesson «У неё ___ сумка»?
questions.explain: Сумка is feminine, so 'green' agrees as «зелёная сумка».

questions.prompt: Which color form is correct in «На небе ___ туча» (storm cloud is feminine, grey)?
questions.explain: Туча is feminine, so the color takes the feminine ending: «серая туча».

questions.prompt: What does «Я люблю голубые глаза» mean?
questions.explain: Голубые глаза means 'light-blue eyes'; голубой is the typical color word for eyes here.

questions.prompt: Which form completes «На столе лежит ___ кольцо» (ring is neuter, golden)?
questions.explain: Кольцо is neuter, so 'golden' agrees as «золотое кольцо», a familiar collocation.

questions.prompt: What does «Это зелёное яблоко очень кислое» say in English?
options: This grey building is very old.
This green apple is very sour.
This red dress is very pretty.
This yellow apple is very sweet.
questions.explain: Зелёное яблоко is 'green apple' (neuter agreement with яблоко); кислое means 'sour'.
